description: Point one unmatched row of an item-priced price book at an item — the answer to a supplier SKU that matched nothing, or matched several items and so was left deliberately unresolved. The row becomes priceable immediately (and is switched back on if it had been skipped at activation). On a book that is already live this adds a rung to that item's ladder, so quotes pinned to it are flagged stale the same way any other price change would flag them. Row ids and the reason each is stuck come from evaluate_price_book.

rowId.description: The unresolved row's id (GUID), as listed in the evaluation's unmatched queue.

name: link_price_book_row_to_item
title: Link Price-Book Row to Item
